verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that card spend becomes expense records: the Card Expenses API returns approved card expenses and lets you mark them synced to an ERP or accounting system, and the Spend product claims to 'automate and reconcile' company spend. Real-time webhooks could trigger downstream processing. Nothing in the pack shows receipts being captured or transactions being coded automatically at the moment of use. missing for 10: automatic receipt capture (e.g., OCR, email or SMS receipt matching), auto-categorization or GL coding of transactions, real-time per-swipe expense creation without manual entry, independent or hands-on corroboration.
